title: Monitoring Azure Functions and App Service
description: Monitor serverless and PaaS workloads using built-in Application Insights integration and diagnostic settings.

data.text: Azure Functions integrates deeply with Application Insights. When you enable Application Insights for a Function App, the runtime automatically captures invocation counts, durations, failures, and dependency calls. You can also use Live Metrics Stream to watch functions execute in real time.

data.title: Enable Application Insights for Functions (Azure CLI)
data.content: Link a Function App to Application Insights:
data.code:
az functionapp create \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --consumption-plan-location eastus \
  --runtime node \
  --functions-version 4 \
  --name myFunctionApp \
  --storage-account mystorageaccount

az monitor app-insights component connect \
  --app myAppInsights \
  --resource-group myResourceGroup \
  --web-app myFunctionApp

data.text: App Service emits detailed logs including HTTP request logs, application logs, and web server logs. Enable diagnostic settings to send these logs to Log Analytics or Blob Storage. Application Insights can also be linked to App Service for application-level telemetry.

data.title: Enable Diagnostic Logs for App Service (Azure CLI)
data.content: Send App Service logs to Log Analytics:
data.code:
az webapp log config --resource-group myResourceGroup --name myWebApp --application-logging true --detailed-error-messages true --failed-request-tracing true --web-server-logging filesystem

az monitor diagnostic-settings create --resource-group myResourceGroup --name app-service-to-la --resource $(az webapp show -g myResourceGroup -n myWebApp --query id -o tsv) --workspace $(az monitor log-analytics workspace show -g myResourceGroup -n myWorkspace --query id -o tsv) --logs '[{"category": "AppServiceConsoleLogs", "enabled": true}, {"category": "AppServiceHTTPLogs", "enabled": true}]'

terms.definition: Console output, invocation logs, and aggregation logs from Azure Functions.
Web server logs, detailed error messages, and failed request traces.
Real-time telemetry stream for live debugging without sampling.

data.title: Enable Smart Detection
data.text: Application Insights Smart Detection automatically identifies performance anomalies and failure patterns. Enable it for all production apps to catch issues without writing custom alert rules.

data.title: Monitor a Function App End-to-End
data.description: Deploy a Function App and verify all monitoring data flows correctly.
steps: Create a Function App with Application Insights enabled.
Add a timer-triggered function that runs every 5 minutes.
Verify invocation data appears in the Functions blade.
Open Live Metrics Stream and watch the function execute.
Check Smart Detection rules for any alerts.
data.expectedOutcome: All telemetry is visible in Application Insights and Log Analytics.
